text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I walk through the camp dorm after a
day of
training with Oguri Cap, Tamamo
Cross stops me
in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I finally caught ya! There's
somethin' I
wanna chat witcha about.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're the one makin' Oguri run outside all day, aren'tcha?
choice_data_list: タマモクロス？どうかしたか？
タマモクロス？どうかしたの？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap has already finished her
training for
the day. I told her to get
some rest before we
parted, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Judgin' by that reaction, I guess not.
Geez, what's
she thinkin'?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ever since she ran with Creek, she's been
actin'
wacky.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya best go check on her. She's at the
beach!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Geez, Creek 'n Oguri both. I told 'em
to have
fun and enjoy their youth for a
change, but they
won't listen.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Naw, forget ya heard anythin'! Just go
and get
Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thank Tamamo Cross for the tip-off,
then hurry
down to the beach.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... One more!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Eek! What are you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask Oguri Cap why she's continuing to
train on
her own accord, and she
hesitantly mutters a
response.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You know how I ran with Creek on the
beach? I...
was confident I'd be able to
beat her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've been in good shape lately, so I
didn't think
2,000 meters would be a
problem for me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There was no reason I should have lost
to Creek.
But, well... you saw what
happened...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It may have technically been a tie, but it
didn't
feel that way to me. I... lost.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If the race were 500 meters longer... she definitely would have beaten me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is a 2,500-meter race.
If that
had been the real thing, I
wouldn't have stood a
chance.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Unless I build up my endurance, I'll
never beat
Creek. I couldn't bear the
thought of losing, and
before I knew it, I
found myself back here again...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry. I should've talked to you first.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But for some reason, I couldn't just allow
myself
to sit around and do nothing. The
urge to keep
running was too strong.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
All I could think about was not losing to
Creek.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: My rival...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I don't want to lose to my
rival!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad Oguri Cap got the chance to
race against
Super Creek during our
training camp. It sure has
ignited her
competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's not all. I also got to see the
result of
all the hard work she's been
putting in.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I have?
choice_data_list: 君は十分強くなってる
貴方は十分強くなってる

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap may still be lacking in terms
of
stamina, but that didn't stop her from
putting up
a good fight.
choice_data_list: 並ばれてからは譲らなかった

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I... could hear you all calling out to me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama, Inari, and... you as well. That's when I told myself I had to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The more support she receives, the
better she
gets. That's another one of
Oguri Cap's strengths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her current track record, she'll have
more
fans than ever cheering her name
at the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You think so? You really... believe in
me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Coming from you, those words
really put
me at ease.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're right. No more acting on whims.
choice_data_list: 焦らず着実に進んでいこう

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So tell me... What do you think I should
do now?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Power, huh?
choice_data_list: さらにパワーをつけよう！
気持ちで負けないようにしよう！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that with strong muscles, she'll
be able
to take that extra step—even
when she's out of
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Got it. Let's focus on strength training.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A positive mindset, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that having the guts to push on
when
things are rough will serve her well
in her races.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
All right. Let's build my mental resilience
then.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Found ya! Geez, whaddaya think you're
doin'?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tama, it's you... What happened?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Forget about me, yous guys're the ones
that are
still out this late!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I was sure your trainer would take ya
back soon,
so I was standin' around
waitin' at the entrance
like a friggin'
idiot!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you're the one who told my
trainer where I
was. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Eh, we just happened to run into each
other.
Anyways, didja manage to work
through whatever
was troublin' ya?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine now. I'm gonna do my
best.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Good to hear. You sure are a nightmare
to look
after, ya know that?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still... I can't deny how zippy ya are. Ya
amaze me
in more ways than one.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nothin', nothin'! Listen, you're not gonna
skip
dinner, are ya? Let's get goin'!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Dinner! I almost forgot!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't go leavin' me behind! Wait
up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap ends up making great strides
during
her time at summer camp.
